description: This file contains functions and type definitions for security fixes, including permission adjustments and ACL resets, within a larger project. It manages security-related operations such as chmod and icacls resets, and applies configuration fixes for security policies.

methods.name: safeChmod
methods.description: Performs a safe chmod operation, skipping symbolic links and checking current permissions before applying changes.

methods.name: safeAclReset
methods.description: Performs a safe ACL reset using icacls, skipping symbolic links and verifying file type.

methods.name: setGroupPolicyAllowlist
methods.description: Modifies group policy settings in the configuration to allowlist mode.

methods.name: applyConfigFixes
methods.description: Applies configuration fixes, such as changing logging settings and group policies.

methods.name: collectChannelSecurityConfigFixMutation
methods.description: Collects security configuration fixes for channel plugins.

methods.name: chmodCredentialsAndAgentState
methods.description: Adjusts permissions for OAuth credentials and agent state directories and files.

methods.name: fixSecurityFootguns
methods.description: Main exported function that performs security permission fixes across the system, handling both Windows and non-Windows platforms.
